summary: The unified-dashboard currency fix satisfies the task invariant on all three clouds. GCP: all five currencyConversionService.inrToUsd(...) calls in aggregateGcpDashboardData are removed and replaced with a per-project, billed-rate conversion — getProjectCurrencyCode resolves the project currency, USD/blank/unknown projects pass through unchanged (no /83), and non-USD projects are scaled by an effective rate (mtdUsd/mtdNative) derived from the new GcpCostService.getUnfilteredMonthToDateSpendUsd, which runs the identical MTD window/filter as the native query but divides cost and credits by the export's currency_conversion_rate at row level. When no billed USD is available (missing rate column, CSP/reseller, query failure, or mtdNative<=0) it returns Optional.empty() and the aggregator keeps native figures and warns once — no hardcoded-rate fallback. MTD/forecast/lastMonth, per-account subAccount figures, cost-history and billing-summary are all scaled consistently; optimizationSummary, savingsSummary, wastedResourceCount, securityScore and activeAlertCount are correctly left unscaled (already USD/unitless), so GCP savings/waste are not over-converted. The GCP double-conversion is gone: the frontend useUnifiedDashboard.ts now does `gcpData = gcpQuery.data ?? null` with convertToUSD/loadRates/useCurrency removed and no dead imports. Azure forecast and cost history are now scaled by the same azureEffectiveRate (monthToDateSpendUsd/monthToDateSpend) so they are USD-consistent with the already-USD MTD, while the per-point forecast boolean flags, security-score, anomaly and waste code are untouched (prior Azure fixes not regressed). AWS mapping is unchanged. Verified independently: `mvn -pl xamops-service -am -q -DskipTests compile` exits 0; GcpUnifiedCurrencyTest (3), AzureForecastCurrencyTest (2) and GcpPricingCurrencyTest (13) all pass with 0 failures/0 errors. Only non-blocking nit: the stale class-level comment (~L73-80) still describes the old inrToUsd/83.0 GCP path that no longer applies to the unified aggregation; documentation-only, no functional impact.
